pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal regions with defined but slightly diffused edges. High spatial area relative to interstitial space with color gradients transitioning from medium brown centers to darker brown peripheries.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light cream-colored pathways forming a complex graph of tri-radial and quadri-radial nodes. Thickness is relatively consistent across the mid-flank, narrowing slightly towards the hindquarters.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Short, stiff, upright bristly texture along the dorsal line with a high-frequency, low-amplitude sawtooth silhouette against the light background.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small, dark avian organism perched on the upper dorsal/neck region, creating a localized silhouette disruption.
